findings.evidence: maintenance documentation will be supplied and the operating system will be tested
findings.rationale: Passive voice omits which party (Yoggie Corporation or the Web Store developers) is responsible for supplying maintenance documentation and testing the operating system.

findings.evidence: Must use a SQL based database.
findings.rationale: Repeats the requirement to use an SQL-based database already mandated in GJ-003 without adding a distinct functional scope.

findings.evidence: Other versions may not be 100% compatible. Also other browsers such as Mozilla or Firefox may not be 100% compatible.
findings.rationale: Non-binding 'may not be 100% compatible' and open-ended 'such as' leave expected compatibility behavior for other browser versions and browsers undefined and untestable.

findings.evidence: Compatibility is only tested and verified
findings.rationale: Passive voice does not identify who is responsible for testing and verifying browser compatibility.

findings.evidence: Compatibility is only tested and verified for Microsoft Internet Explorer version 6 and 7, Netscape Communicator Version 4 and 5.
findings.rationale: Restates the same supported browser list (IE 6 and 7, Netscape Communicator 4 and 5) already specified in GJ-001.

findings.evidence: Shall install online help for users via the web interface
findings.rationale: Omits the subject/actor responsible for installing online help (e.g., the system installer, developers, or administrator).

findings.evidence: Operations and Maintenance manual, Users Guide book, and Installation Instructions for the Administrator
findings.rationale: Attachment ambiguity: it is unclear whether 'for the Administrator' applies only to 'Installation Instructions' or to all three listed documents (including 'Users Guide book').

findings.evidence: Shall deliver Operations and Maintenance manual, Users Guide book, and Installation Instructions for the Administrator.
findings.rationale: Omits the subject/actor responsible for delivering the required documentation.

findings.evidence: Assume the delivery of development, test and evaluate samples of the USB system from Yoggie.
findings.rationale: Omits the delivery schedule, sample quantities, receiving actor, and fallback condition if Yoggie does not deliver the samples.

findings.evidence: Assume Yoggie will freeze the baseline of the USB system after delivery.
findings.rationale: Does not specify which delivery milestone triggers the baseline freeze (development, test, evaluation, or final delivery) or the duration and scope of the freeze.

findings.evidence: The system will do periodic backups
findings.rationale: 'periodic' is unquantified with no testable backup frequency, and 'will' is used instead of the mandatory 'shall'.

findings.evidence: periodic backups through a live internet connection
findings.rationale: References periodic backups without specifying the numeric backup interval/unit or retention period, and omits error handling if the internet connection is unavailable.

findings.evidence: The system shall validate credit cards against fraud.
findings.rationale: Describes fraud validation on the happy path without specifying what happens when fraud is detected or validation fails (e.g., reject payment, alert administrator, log event).

findings.evidence: all sensitive information
findings.rationale: 'sensitive information' is subjective and undefined; the requirement does not specify which data fields or transmissions are classified as sensitive.

findings.evidence: auto detect IP DOS attacks and block IP automatically
findings.rationale: Omits the detection criteria or traffic threshold defining an IP DOS attack, as well as the block duration and unblocking/recovery procedure.

findings.evidence: The system shall detect consecutive failed login attempts.
findings.rationale: Specifies a detection condition without stating the resulting system action (e.g., account lockout, delay, alert, or recovery) and omits the numeric count of consecutive failed attempts.

findings.evidence: validate 'existing' credit card in system after each log in
findings.rationale: Describes credit card validation upon login without specifying what happens when the stored credit card is invalid, expired, declined, or absent.

findings.evidence: too large in size
findings.rationale: 'too large in size' is subjective and provides no measurable criterion for when image compression must occur.

findings.evidence: image files that are too large in size
findings.rationale: References a file-size threshold without providing a numeric limit and unit (e.g., MB or KB) or target compressed size/quality.

findings.evidence: The system will employ on demand asynchronous loading for faster execution of pages.
findings.rationale: 'faster execution of pages' is an unquantified comparative with no baseline or measurable page-load target, and 'will' is used instead of 'shall'.

findings.evidence: The system shall validate email address existence.
findings.rationale: Specifies email existence validation without defining what the system must do when an email address does not exist or validation fails.

findings.evidence: easy to use
findings.rationale: 'easy to use' is subjective and unquantified, providing no testable usability criteria.

findings.evidence: easy to learn
findings.rationale: 'easy to learn' is subjective and unquantified, lacking measurable learnability criteria (such as onboarding time or task completion rate).

findings.evidence: utilize help bubbles to assist managers, customers, and administrators
findings.rationale: Omits which screens, controls, or user actions trigger help bubbles and what assistance content they must display.

findings.evidence: easy to locate
findings.rationale: 'easy to locate' is subjective and lacks measurable UI layout or discoverability criteria.

findings.evidence: friend easy to read
findings.rationale: 'friend easy to read' (typo for 'friendly, easy to read') is subjective and provides no measurable readability or error-message standards.

findings.evidence: consistent symbols and colors for clear notifications
findings.rationale: 'consistent' and 'clear' are subjective and unquantified without a defined symbol set, color palette, or notification specification.

findings.evidence: interchangeable plugins
findings.rationale: 'interchangeable plugins' is underspecified and unmeasurable without defining the plugin interfaces, supported extension points, or compatibility criteria.

findings.evidence: easily updatable
findings.rationale: 'easily updatable' is subjective and unquantified, lacking measurable effort, downtime, or procedure criteria.

findings.evidence: easy to upgrade
findings.rationale: 'easy to upgrade' is subjective and unquantified, providing no testable upgrade effort or downtime threshold.

findings.evidence: extremely portable
findings.rationale: 'extremely portable' is subjective and unquantified, lacking concrete portability metrics or supported host environment constraints.

findings.evidence: easy to migrate or backed up
findings.rationale: 'easy' is subjective and unquantified, providing no measurable criteria for migration or backup effort, steps, or duration.

findings.evidence: should be able to
findings.rationale: Non-binding modal 'should' makes it unclear whether debug mode support is mandatory or optional.

findings.evidence: run under debug mode
findings.rationale: Does not specify how debug mode is activated or deactivated, who is authorized to enable it, or what diagnostic behavior it produces.

findings.evidence: should be able to
findings.rationale: Non-binding modal 'should' makes it unclear whether running test credit card transactions is mandatory or optional.

findings.evidence: run test credit card transactions
findings.rationale: Omits preconditions, authorized user roles, and isolation rules ensuring test credit card transactions do not trigger real financial charges.

findings.evidence: should be able to
findings.rationale: Non-binding modal 'should' makes it unclear whether running test shipping orders is mandatory or optional.

findings.evidence: run test shipping orders
findings.rationale: Omits preconditions, authorized user roles, and isolation rules ensuring test shipping orders do not initiate real shipments or vendor notifications.

findings.evidence: should be able to
findings.rationale: Non-binding modal 'should' makes it unclear whether creating a test environment is mandatory or optional.

findings.evidence: create test environment of weborder system
findings.rationale: Omits who may create the test environment, what configuration or data it contains, and how it is isolated from production.

findings.evidence: weborder system
findings.rationale: Refers to the application as 'weborder system' instead of the established system name 'Web Store' used in GJ-001, GJ-002, and GJ-005.

findings.evidence: The system hardware shall be fixed and patched via an internet connection.
findings.rationale: Passive voice omits which actor (Yoggie Corporation, developers, or administrator) performs the remote fixes and patches, and omits error handling if the internet connection is unavailable.

findings.evidence: The system hardware shall be fixed and patched via an internet connection.
findings.rationale: Requiring post-delivery hardware/platform fixing and patching via an internet connection conflicts with GJ-010, which assumes Yoggie will freeze the USB system baseline after delivery.

findings.evidence: coordinate on future enhancement and features with our organization
findings.rationale: 'coordinate' and 'future enhancement and features' are vague and untestable, and 'our organization' is an unidentified stakeholder.

findings.evidence: Yoggie shall coordinate on future enhancement and features with our organization.
findings.rationale: Omits the schedule, process, deliverables, and decision criteria governing coordination on future enhancements.

findings.evidence: OS: Apache web server
findings.rationale: Specifies 'Apache web server' as the operating system, contradicting GJ-002 which defines Slackware Linux 2.6 as the operating system and Apache Web Server as the web server.
